scope: General current StepEventC payload meaning for normal Applied rows only. Not event values for a particular source, not a new guard/refusal/publication policy, and not an assertion that a source/prestate is admitted/reachable. Existing source-derived/shared-method correlation remains explicit.

site.normal_selected_rows: Some(owner_site(pre)). This is the preimage control/frame/expression site, not post-control or live-helper common.site copied blindly.

owner_site.Eval: Inspect pre.view.expressions[control.expr]: Literal→EvalLiteral; Var→EvalVar; Let→EvalLet; Binary→EvalBinary; Unary→EvalUnary; If→EvalIf; Call→EvalCall; Match→EvalMatch; Construct→EvalConstruct.
owner_site.Error: No normal selected owner_site result; no fabricated SiteTag is supplied.

ordered_priority: Else Some(kind(post.helper)) when post.helper is present
Else helperPlan(site(pre),pre) when pre.result is present (the returned Option may be None)
Else Selected.helper_kind only when event_kind is HelperEnter,HelperVisit,HelperExit,HelperFail orBookkeeping under Applied
helper_kind.kind: Exact live HelperControlC variant name among Scalar,EnvGet,EnvPut,Find,Bind,Append,Validate,Equal,Match,Plan,Build; not a scalar mode/result tag.

helperPlan.RetRight: RightF with Eq→Some(Equal), another BinaryOp→Some(Scalar); absent/wrong frame→None
helperPlan.Enter: Some(Bind) only if control.Enter.function is Some; otherwiseNone
helperPlan.Cases: Some(Plan) for origin-expression Match.plan Some. Some(Match) for origin-expression Match.plan None and control.Cases.arms nonempty. OtherwiseNone.

helper_kind.important_legacy_case: Selected.helper_kind for LegacyComplete is None, but staged pre.result still uses helperPlan via the earlier priority branch; do not overwrite it to None.

origin_reference_cursor.meaning: Retain raw native u128 and Option tags; do not normalize/replace pre-helper origin with current cursor. Refused-entry/P2 Publish exceptions are outside this normal Applied declaration.

result_tag.HelperExit_or_HelperFail: Map post.result, if present, to its exact HelperResultTagC variant
result_tag.LegacyComplete: Map pre.result, if present, to its exact HelperResultTagC variant
result_tag.tag_mapping: Validated,EnvFound,EnvMissing,EnvUpdated,FindFound,FindMissing,BindOk,BindBad,AppendDone,ScalarValue,ScalarError,ScalarSelector,ScalarTypeTest,EqualDone,MatchMatched,MatchNoMatch,PlanMatched,PlanNoMatch,BuildDone map to same named tag; no payload is converted into root Outcome.

helper_phase.before: None when pre.helper absent; otherwise phase(pre.helper)
helper_phase.after: None when post.helper absent; otherwise phase(post.helper)

helper_cursor.before: None when pre.helper absent; otherwise cursor(pre.helper,pre.tasks.len())
helper_cursor.after: None when post.helper absent; otherwise cursor(post.helper,post.tasks.len())

cursor_mapping.Validate,Equal: Some(tasks length of that same before/after state)

other_general_fields.source_occurrence: Current LocatorC::Occurrence from pre.admission.view.occurrences[pre.control_origin] and exact ordered path slice; Entry false/function0; previous ABI05 unchanged, no digest field invented.
other_general_fields.step_id: Whole post.run_id (unchanged by normal row), ordinal = before-state consumed_work. Not assumed equal to the all-events array index if uncharged events are present elsewhere.
other_general_fields.reference_cursor_delta: 1 for Applied LegacyComplete,0 for other normal Applied event kinds
other_general_fields.logical_depth_before_after: raw frames length of each state independently
other_general_fields.task_cursor_before_after: raw tasks length of each state independently
other_general_fields.outcome_tag_payload: Tag and complete payload of post.outcome, without inferring Rejected from a control/helper error
other_general_fields.boundary: None when post.outcome Running,Terminal otherwise; no source-suspension/boundary encoding claim

declaration_only: No source-specific IDs, table rows, event sequence, state snapshot, counters, target ordinal or predicted output cells supplied; no implementation body in SAFE file.
independent_role_boundary: Root must explicitly authorize this additional declaration before oracle consumes it. Original parametric freeze/input/adopted canonical contract unchanged; any new literal-prefix freeze is additive.

complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.step_id: ExpandedStepIdC{run_id:whole post.run_id,ordinal:before normal owner_step consumed_work}; Arc identity is not serialized
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.event_kind: Selected.event_kind as given by exact enabled source row mapping, not inferred from state delta
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.site: Normal selected row: Some(owner_site(pre)); mapping/prerequisites declared in site section
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.helper_kind: Ordered source resolution declared in helper_kind section; prehelper,posthelper,staged-pre-result-plan,then selected-helper-row fallback
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.disposition: Applied; this declaration excludes publication/refusal/exception/Terminal branches
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.work_delta: 1 for this normal Applied owner path
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.helper_work_delta: 1 when Selected.helper_eligible,otherwise0; selected_for defines eligible iff event_kind != LegacyComplete
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.helper_visits_delta: Selected.helper_visits, exactly the current normative selected row visits; not derived from helper-work or event count
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.alloc_deltas: AllocDeltasC copies ValidatedPlan.delta alloc_data_nodes,alloc_data_fields,alloc_environment_cells (no cap-refusal branch); no inferred retained-allocation total
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.result_tag: Normal exit/failure maps post.result; normal LegacyComplete maps pre.result; other kindsNone; exact map declared
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.origin_reference_cursor: pre helper common origin first,then post helper common origin,then pre.reference_cursor if pre.resultSome,otherwiseNone
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.source_expr_id: pre.control_origin, not post origin or selected expression ID invented from current control
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.source_occurrence: LocatorC::Occurrence formed from pre.view.occurrences[pre.control_origin] owner/function/path into pre.view.occurrence_paths, exact ordered slice; Entry sentinel false/function0; no source digest added
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.exhausted_kind: None for this normal Applied owner path
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.outcome_tag: Exact variant tag of post.outcome among Running,Halted,Rejected,Exhausted
complete_28_field_order_and_meaning.outcome_payload: Entire post.outcome native variant/payload, no projection or helper/control-error reinterpretation

Root_boundary: Do not hand this source-derived general extension to oracle until Root adopts its exact pin after faithfulness review. Oracle current canonical whole-image prefix remains private; no current/future states/counts/results read.
